Adjacency matris shows the adjacency of points

===Properties===

# if a graph is loop free then all diagonal entries are zeroes
# If there are no parallel edges all entries are zero and one
# in a simple graph the diagonal entries are all 0 and all other entries are either 1 or 0
# In an undirected graph the matrix is symmetrical on the diagonal<br />



=== ORdering ===
Theorem: order of the elements in the matrix are arbitrary and isomorphic graphs have the same adjacency matrices
